mission: Implement critical functional gaps from the comprehensive plan and Beads, checkpointing substantive changes directly to main through GitHub with no PRs.

authority.repository: User explicitly authorized direct main commits using GitHub.
authority.operational: No live camera connections or deployment changes; all authored tests use injected I/O or local fixtures.

delivered.verification: Native tests remain unverified; exact limitation retained in prior handoff.

delivered.feature: RTSP request-target authority bound to TCP route
delivered.scope: Validate immutable first wire line using the existing credential-free URI parser before queue ownership, send reservation or socket I/O. Refuse with RequestScope and unchanged ClientRequest. Preserve matching bytes and usable valid route.

threat_addressed: A request prepared for one authority, including Digest authorization material, could previously be queued onto another authority's owner-approved TCP route because only the link's authority was checked.
compatibility: Exact textual authority semantics follow existing session validation; no DNS, default-port, case or alias normalization was introduced.
ClientRequest constructors and wire bytes are unchanged.
Scope refusal is payload-free and does not consume the request or its send allowance.
No same-authority session, ingress, generation or principal binding is implied; those remain with the explicit owner.
No dependencies, pins, qualification gates or retry policies were weakened.

validation.cases: Eight mismatched authority forms, actual-vs-authority ports, genuine SHA-256 Digest challenge retry, untouched request bytes/CSeq/command, redacted errors, zero socket work, unchanged send allowance and subsequent valid dispatch.
validation.independent_review: Exact rescued source and shared URI/client construction, CLI error classification and reconnect behavior reviewed by root and a separate agent; no blocker found.
validation.original_formatting: Pinned rustfmt --edition 2024 --check and git diff --check returned exit 0 for the RTSP changes before environment loss.
validation.final_source: Recovered from captured applied patches. Client blob 11f79067042fbebcf42272b038b1c23effb33859 and TCP blob 2f54dd146820bf82a94447aadf1e88e04274ea3d match observed local git diff identities. Test blob 691954effe764f2b9aa22cc8cb9bccdfbccc24fc was recovered from the exact captured patch and source; no final native check was available.
validation.native_test_outcome: Not executed to an observed result. The serial validation queue was blocked by earlier core/ledger compiler SIGKILL and subsequent executor loss; no RTSP test pass claimed.
validation.integrity: Changed-file SHA-256 manifest overlay updated from the published bytes; no full native worktree audit claim.
validation.qualification: No real-camera, full-workspace, deployment-throughput or release qualification.

retry.environment: Exact nightly-2026-08-31 and locked registry closure; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1; CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0; CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0
retry.dependency: asupersync 0.5.0; compiler needs a functioning host with adequate capacity.

related_requirements.scope: Owner-authorized bounded RTSP transport; this security contract is a narrow implementation improvement, not closure of a broad ingest or device-qualification Bead.

continuations.work: Execute the ledger and RTSP contracts and verify final formatting on an available host without changing pins or weakening acceptance gates.
Durable replay still retains full historical object maps. Introduce an explicit current-snapshot mode only with exact oracle/prefix/crash parity and preserved canonical batch and identity history.
Request-owned MCP execution/cancellation remains a previously identified substantial gap; use Asupersync ownership, bounded admission and drain/finalize contracts.

obligations: Both implemented functional increments are committed directly to main; no PRs.
Outstanding native validation is explicit; broad Beads are not closed on source review.
